mission: Maintain the reliability and usability of the documented public API. Inspect current source, tests, documentation and committed feedback. Prioritize reproducible user-facing failures, define acceptance criteria, implement and verify one focused change, then inspect again. Wait when there is no well-supported work; report a blocker when a product decision is required.
constraints: Preserve documented public behavior unless a change is explicitly required by this mission.
Do not change credentials, dependencies, CI, security policy, or deployment configuration.
Prefer work supported by reproducible defects or concrete user-facing evidence.
